dimensions.label: Problem Clarity
dimensions.evidence: The ideate leg writes nothing to disk (bookings/ideation-ideate.md:9-15) and the refine handover is /clear then a bare `RUN: /ideation:ideation` (no `argument` key), so the brainstorm conclusion ideation can carry as starting evidence is lost at exactly the boundary it is needed.

dimensions.label: Goal Definition
dimensions.evidence: Goals G1-G4 were drafted as observable output changes (RUN line content, a file at a named path, prompt conditions) and accepted as drafted.

dimensions.label: Success Criteria
dimensions.evidence: Six command checks against npm test goldens and CLI/commands tests plus one named judgment run; the C4 assumption (ignored files do not block `git worktree remove`) was verified by a scratch repo test during the interview.

dimensions.label: Scope Boundaries
dimensions.evidence: Legs in scope are refine and specs only; the out-of-scope list (nine items, each with a reason) was accepted as drafted.

dimensions.label: Consistency
dimensions.evidence: The HTML-format request conflicted with inline passing and was resolved by passing the brief's path, with facts inline; brief targeting resolves at run time so a through leg (contract) is skipped over correctly.

problem: `/waybill:next` hands each leg's session a bare command. For refine, the paste list is `/clear`, `/model opus`, `/effort high`, `/waybill:next <branch>/refine`, and the resulting `RUN:` line is `/ideation:ideation` with no argument — the refine booking has no `argument` key, and the only arguments Waybill can ever pass are one closed-enum fact (`change-id`, `branch`, or none).

The ideate leg deliberately writes nothing to disk, and ideate → bay runs in one session, so the brainstorm conclusion (decision, assumptions, rejected alternatives, exclusions) exists only in that conversation. The `/clear` before refine discards it, and ideation's intake — which is built to carry a brainstorm conclusion as starting evidence — starts from zero. `/spec:propose` in the specs leg has the same shape: free-text input, nothing passed.

Waybill itself is deterministic Node with no model, so it can assemble facts it infers (branch, bay, slug dir, skipped legs, next leg) but cannot summarise a conversation. The summary has to be written by the session finishing the previous leg, before its `/clear`.
goals: G1: A pasted `/waybill:next <branch>/refine` emits `RUN: /ideation:ideation` whose argument carries `Brief: <bay>/.waybill/handoff/refine.html (read first)` plus a Waybill context block (branch, bay, ideation slug dir if any, skipped legs, the next leg after this session); with no brief present it carries the context block only and the output prints a no-brief warning line.
G2: The same holds for the specs leg and `/spec:propose`.

G3: `/waybill:brief` writes `<bay>/.waybill/handoff/<leg>.html` for the next leg that starts after a `/clear`, resolved at run time; the directory self-ignores via its own `.gitignore` (`*`), `git status` in the bay stays clean, and cleanup still removes the bay.

G4: The brief is triggered automatically after a run-mode `/waybill:next <branch>/<leg>` finishes its wrapped command, and offered via AskUserQuestion on an end-of-leg display (`/waybill:next` and `/waybill:bay` handovers) only when the next leg takes a brief, the bay exists, and no brief exists for it yet.

mvp.item: `waybill brief [<branch>]` CLI subcommand: resolves the docket like `next` (fleet()/parseTarget, so it works from the trunk right after /waybill:bay), finds the next post-/clear leg, ensures `<bay>/.waybill/handoff/` with a `*` .gitignore, prints BRIEF FOR / WRITE TO and the booking's brief guidance; listed in USAGE, the COMMANDS map, and the help card within its 45-line budget
mvp.reason: Keeps path, targeting and ignore logic in tested code; the model only authors content

mvp.item: Booking `brief:` key: a one-line guidance string (the frontmatter parser accepts flat single-line scalars only), added to OPTIONAL and the Booking typedef, set on ideation-refine and openspec-specs, honoured in overlays
mvp.reason: Tells the brief author what the receiving command needs; marks which legs take a brief

mvp.item: RUN argument assembly for brief-taking legs: brief path line plus Waybill context block; no-brief warning line
mvp.reason: The deterministic half of the layered design; G1/G2

mvp.item: Display-mode keyed line: `next --markdown` and `bay --markdown` emit an exported `BRIEF:` keyed line when the next post-/clear leg has a `brief:` key, the bay exists, and no brief file exists yet
mvp.reason: Command files key only on literals the renderer exports (ENTER_BAY/RUN/NEXT_LEG); only the CLI can resolve overlays to know whether a leg takes a brief

mvp.item: New commands/brief.md (`/waybill:brief`) that runs `waybill brief` and writes the HTML with Write
mvp.reason: The explicit command the user asked for

mvp.item: commands/next.md: run `/waybill:brief` after a run-mode wrapped command; on the `BRIEF:` keyed line, AskUserQuestion before showing the waybill

commands/bay.md: the same `BRIEF:`-keyed AskUserQuestion; allowed-tools gains Skill and SlashCommand so a Yes can actually run /waybill:brief, with the pinned tool list in tests/commands.test.js updated
mvp.reason: The ideate session reaches refine's waybill through bay, so this is where the brainstorm brief gets written

mvp.item: Goldens and tests for all of the above; README, docs/guide reference/glossary/ride-along, and openspec living specs (handover, command-surface) updated
mvp.reason: Learning (next-from-anywhere): behaviour prose outside src/ goes stale unless listed

decisions.decision: Layered context: Waybill-inferred facts always, plus a model-written brief when one exists
decisions.reason: Facts alone lose the brainstorm at /clear; a brief alone lets a model misstate facts Waybill already knows

decisions.decision: Store the brief as an untracked file in the bay, self-ignored via .waybill/handoff/.gitignore
decisions.rejected: Git common dir; committed on the branch
decisions.reason: Owner wants it visible in the worktree; committing pollutes the PR diff and diff-based inference

decisions.decision: Key the file by the reading leg (handoff/refine.html)
decisions.reason: Exact lookup; no need to resolve the latest done leg across skips

decisions.decision: A separate /waybill:brief command, run automatically after a run-mode leg and offered at end-of-leg display
decisions.rejected: Display run authors the brief implicitly; each booking body asks for it
decisions.reason: Owner wants an explicit, nameable step that next orchestrates

decisions.decision: Start-of-leg run assembles and passes; it never generates a brief
decisions.rejected: Generate a brief from disk when none exists
decisions.reason: Disk cannot recover an unwritten brainstorm; more model work per leg for little gain

decisions.rejected: A printed line; a /waybill:brief paste block
decisions.reason: A printed line is skimmable; a paste block runs even when there is nothing to brief

decisions.decision: Only refine and specs take a brief in this change
decisions.reason: specs has the same gap; execute's /spec:apply argument handling is unverified for extra text

decisions.decision: HTML only, passed by path with facts inline
decisions.rejected: Inline stripped HTML; HTML plus Markdown twin; a format setting
decisions.reason: Path passing needs no converter and keeps one source file; no demand for Markdown yet

decisions.decision: The brief targets the next leg that starts after a /clear, resolved when /waybill:brief runs
decisions.reason: refine continues into contract in the same session, so the brief written afterwards must be for specs

decisions.decision: Display runs emit a `BRIEF:` keyed line the command files key on
decisions.rejected: Command files decide from prose conditions on their own
decisions.reason: Critic (hidden-dependency): only the CLI can resolve overlays to know a leg takes a brief, and command files key only on exported literals

decisions.decision: bay.md allowed-tools gains Skill and SlashCommand
decisions.rejected: Keep bay.md's pinned minimal tool list
decisions.reason: Critic (hidden-dependency): without them a Yes on bay's prompt silently does nothing, and bay is where the ideate brief is written

decisions.decision: `waybill brief` takes an optional <branch> and resolves like `next`
decisions.reason: Critic (hidden-dependency): the ideate session is still on the trunk after /waybill:bay

decisions.decision: Success checks guard on test/golden existence before running
decisions.reason: Critic (success-criteria): a name filter matching nothing exits 0, so the originals passed before any work
